title: Implement F5-TTS backend with MLX support
description: Implement F5-TTS pluggable backend with native MLX on Apple Silicon and PyTorch fallback, add Gherkin scenarios, worker-image registry, and tests.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented F5-TTS pluggable backend in cli and worker-image with native MLX on Apple Silicon Darwin and PyTorch fallback on Linux/CUDA. Added Gherkin scenarios for registry, resolution without model load, and voice resolution. All quality gates, behave features, and pytest tests pass.
